changelog: - **Monte Carlo CSVs: a Pool named like a formula opens as text.** The runs, series and summary CSVs of a Monte Carlo result wrote a Pool's name as it is, so a name beginning with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` could be read as a formula by a spreadsheet. Such a name now starts with `'` wherever these files write it, as in the Timeline's run CSV; every other name and every number is written as before.
